Sometime before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] personal contingent of Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], known as [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], '''raided''' the [[Ulkantha asteroids]] to break up [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] activity there. In the process, they uncovered evidence of a [[Unidentified Sakiyan smuggling ring|smuggling ring]] made up of members of the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] [[Species/Legends|species]], with its headquarters in [[Syvris shadowport]] near [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
